notes.title: 《Avoid The Rain》is about to become free
notes.notes:
From what I've observed, this game hasn't seen any new players for a year, and I've been pouring all my energy into the creation of another new game. The outdated engine has also made it difficult for me to continue updating this one. I still have a great fondness for the theme of rainy days, and perhaps I will remake this game in the future. As it stands, this game was merely a step-by-step attempt at exploring new paths. I am aware that the game is poorly made and deviates from my original design draft. I will continue to reflect on where exactly I strayed from my initial vision and am trying to rectify it. I will keep searching for the mistakes until I find them, and only then will I embark on a brand new production.

I apologize to all the players who have paid for this game. I hope that by the time I finish remaking this game, you will still be following me. As a gesture of apology, I will offer the remade new game to you for free.

Most of my time in life is spent researching how to do better, and in doing so, I've missed out on many people who love me. I also hope you can forgive me, as I worry that if I were to put down my pursuits to embrace your love, you might leave me because of my lack of achievement. Perhaps I am avoiding this unstable emotion, or perhaps I just want to give everyone an explanation. I've placed this explanation within the game, hidden in my own world where my sincere apologies reside. When you return, you will see it.

The game will now be free, in the hopes of getting to know more friends who play games.
